contributions.detail: *** THE DeBRY BASIS TRAP IS PRESENT ON THIS FILING - VERIFIED AT THE PAGE. *** Schedule A (p3) is the county grid, PRESENT and ENTIRELY BLANK (15 ruled data rows, no ink). Its two footer cells have DIFFERENT SCOPES: 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' = '0' (the PERIOD figure) while 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' = $64,893.50, which is the CYCLE-CUMULATIVE figure and equals Summary line 1 Column A AND Column B (identical on line 1). The PERIOD contribution figure is Summary LINE 4 = '0' - line 4 is captioned 'From Line 1 Column A' but the filer did NOT copy 64,893.50 into it; he wrote 0, and lines 5/7 prove 0 is what he meant. So the anchor whose SCOPE matches a blank schedule is line 4 / the page subtotal, both 0, and zero rows reconciles EXACTLY. Gating on the schedule grand total would have manufactured a false $64,893.50 delta out of a filing that is exact.

expenditures.detail: *** SAME TRAP, SAME PAGE. *** Schedule B (p4) prints 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' $101.89 (PERIOD) and 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' $25,510.73 (CYCLE-CUMULATIVE = Summary line 2 COLUMN B). The 3 transcribed rows sum 28.89 + 33.00 + 40.00 = 101.89 = the page subtotal = Summary LINE 6 = the period figure. EXACT. || The scope test also resolves what Column A means on this filing: line 2 Column A $25,408.84 is the PRIOR cumulative, because Column B - Column A = 25,510.73 - 25,408.84 = 101.89 = exactly this period's spend. So on line 2 the filer's Column A is 'cumulative through the previous report' and Column B is 'cumulative including this one' - NEITHER is 'total this period', which is what the pre-printed Column A header says. stated_total_expenditures ($25,408.84) is recorded verbatim because it is the Column-A figure the schema takes, but it is NOT comparable to another filer's period total. No in-kind marker anywhere on this filing.
